name: Ioana Iacob
bio: Ioana Iacob is a Romanian film and theater actress .She was born in Timisoara, Romania. She graduated Of the Acting Department in German within the Faculty of Music of the West University of Timisoara in 2002.In 2007, she plays first role in the movie Cocosul decapitat.Other notable roles in films : I Do Not Care If We Go Down in History as Barbarians (2018) and In the Face of Crime (2010).

credits.title: We Might As Well Be Dead
